title: Anthropic is getting heat for staying silent on open source AI
excerpt: Anthropic is facing criticism from across Silicon Valley for failing to sign an open letter defending open-weight AI models.
content_html:
Anthropic gets heat for being the only major AI lab not supporting open models

By Tom Carter

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

The tech industry is rallying around open-weight AI, but one major lab is staying conspicuously silent.

Anthropic is drawing criticism from across Silicon Valley for not signing an open letter advocating for open-weight AI as Washington considers restrictions on some Chinese models.

On Friday, over two dozen companies — including Nvidia, Meta, and Microsoft — signed "Open Weights and American AI Leadership," endorsing open-weights, which means developers can download, modify, and deploy AI models on their own infrastructure.

Over the weekend, several other major names in AI signed the letter: OpenAI, Google, and SpaceX.

It means that, as of Monday, the only major frontier AI lab not to back the industry-wide defense of open models is Anthropic — and the Claude maker is catching some serious heat for it.

"The entire tech industry (save for Anthropic) has come out in favor of open source AI," said David Sacks, a venture capitalist and former AI czar for the Trump administration.

"They won't stop until they kneecap open source. The rest of the industry needs to watch these guys like a hawk," he wrote in a post on X.

"Proud that @OpenAI signed the letter. Ant is silent on it," wrote Peter Steinberger, an OpenAI employee and the founder of agentic platform OpenClaw, in his own X post.

Bill Gurley, a general partner at VC firm Benchmark, also criticized Anthropic for not signing the letter and suggested the company was attempting to preserve its position in the AI race.

"Excited to see Anthropic acknowledge the real problem with open is it competes with their corporate economic strategy. The 'awareness' here is revealing," wrote Gurley in an X post responding to an Anthropic employee.

"Who DIDN'T sign the Open Weight letter is far more interesting than who did," wrote Kai-Fu Lee, a former Google and Microsoft exec who founded Chinese open-model startup 01.AI, while tagging Anthropic's Claude AI in his X post.

Anthropic did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei has previously warned that developers lose control of frontier AI models once their weights are released. Anthropic has instead favored gated access to powerful models, launching Project Glasswing, an initiative to give vetted companies early access to its powerful cyber models to fix security flaws, earlier this year.

China dials up open model debate

The debate over open models has been supercharged by the recent launch of Kimi K3, an open-weight model built by the Chinese AI lab Moonshot that rivals the performance of top US closed models on some benchmarks.

Last week, a top White House official accused Moonshot of using Anthropic's Fable AI model to train K3, a practice known as distillation, while Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent suggested the US government could sanction Chinese open-source AI models that are found to have distilled their US rivals. China has, broadly, pursued a more open approach to AI than the US.

The argument for open-weight AI was boosted last week after Hugging Face said it used a model from China's Z.ai in its defense against a hack from OpenAI's rogue AI agent. Hugging Face said it was unable to use closed AI models because of restrictions on them.

The outpouring of support for open models continued on Monday with Nvidia announcing the launch of the Open Secure AI Alliance, an initiative advocating for open AI models in cybersecurity, which was backed by Microsoft, SpaceX, and other tech firms.

content_html_zh:
Anthropic 因成为唯一不支持开放模型的主要人工智能实验室而受到热议

作者：Tom Carter 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

科技行业正在围绕开放式人工智能团结起来，但一个主要实验室却明显保持沉默。

在华盛顿考虑限制某些中国模型之际，Anthropic 因没有签署一封倡导开放权重人工智能的公开信而受到来自硅谷各地的批评。

周五，包括英伟达、Meta 和微软在内的二十多家公司签署了《开放权重和美国人工智能领导力》，支持开放权重，这意味着开发人员可以在自己的基础设施上下载、修改和部署人工智能模型。

周末，人工智能领域的其他几家知名公司签署了这封信：OpenAI、谷歌和 SpaceX。

这意味着，截至周一，唯一一个不支持全行业开放模型防御的主要前沿人工智能实验室是 Anthropic，而 Claude 制造商正因此受到一些关注。

风险投资家、特朗普政府前人工智能沙皇戴维·萨克斯 (David Sacks) 表示：“整个科技行业（除了 Anthropic）都支持开源人工智能。”

“他们不会停止，除非他们彻底废除开源。 行业的其他人需要像鹰一样监视这些人，”他在 X 上的一篇帖子中写道。

“@OpenAI 签署了这封信，对此我感到很自豪。 Ant 对此保持沉默。”OpenAI 员工、代理平台 OpenClaw 创始人 Peter Steinberger 在他自己的 X 帖子中写道。

风险投资公司 Benchmark 的普通合伙人 Bill Gurley 也批评 Anthropic 没有签署这封信，并暗示该公司试图保持其在人工智能竞赛中的地位。

“很高兴看到 Anthropic 承认开放的真正问题是它与他们的企业经济战略竞争。 这里的‘意识’很能说明问题，”格利在回复一位 Anthropic 员工的 X 帖子中写道。

“谁没有签署 Open Weight 信，比谁签署了更有趣，”谷歌和微软前高管、中国开放模式初创公司 01.AI 的创始人李开复在他的 X 帖子中标记了 Anthropic 的 Claude AI 时写道。

Anthropic 没有立即回应置评请求。

Anthropic 首席执行官 Dario Amodei 此前曾警告称，一旦权重发布，开发人员就会失去对前沿人工智能模型的控制。 相反，Anthropic 更倾向于限制对强大模型的访问，并于今年早些时候推出了 Project Glasswing，该计划旨在让经过审查的公司尽早访问其强大的网络模型以修复安全缺陷。

中国开启公开模式辩论

最近推出的 Kimi K3 加剧了有关开放模型的争论，Kimi K3 是由中国人工智能实验室 Moonshot 构建的开放权重模型，在某些基准测试中的性能可与美国顶级封闭模型的性能相媲美。

上周，一位白宫高级官员指责 Moonshot 使用 Anthropic 的 Fable AI 模型来训练 K3，这种做法被称为蒸馏，而财政部长 Scott Bessent 则建议美国政府可以制裁那些被发现蒸馏了美国竞争对手的中国开源人工智能模型。 总体而言，中国对人工智能采取了比美国更加开放的态度。

上周，Hugging Face 表示，它使用了中国 Z.ai 的模型来防御 OpenAI 流氓人工智能代理的黑客攻击，这引发了关于开放权重人工智能的争论。 Hugging Face 表示，由于封闭式 AI 模型受到限制，因此无法使用它们。

周一，对开放模型的大力支持仍在继续，英伟达宣布成立开放安全人工智能联盟，这是一项倡导网络安全领域开放人工智能模型的倡议，得到了微软、SpaceX 和其他科技公司的支持。
